cards.name: Dwarven Vigilantes
cards.oracleText: Whenever this creature attacks and isn't blocked, you may have it deal damage equal to its power to target creature. If you do, this creature assigns no combat damage this turn.

cards.name: Dwarven Warriors
cards.oracleText: {T}: Target creature with power 2 or less can't be blocked this turn.

cards.name: Dwarven Sea Clan
cards.oracleText: {T}: Choose target attacking or blocking creature whose controller controls an Island. This creature deals 2 damage to that creature at end of combat. Activate only before the end of combat step.
